title: NFL Draft Chime
blurb: The NFL draft chime — the broadcast sting that means a pick is in and someone's life is about to change. Sports edits use it constantly, but the meme usage is broader: play it whenever any selection is made. Choosing a restaurant, picking teams at recess, deciding who tells the landlord. The pick is in. The chime makes it official.
origin: The 'pick is in' broadcast chime from NFL Draft coverage.
